bullets: Added the GPT-6.1 Sol model to the free model picker as a US-free, paid-elsewhere promotional row capped at one session per account per day.
Added a per-account daily session cap of one session for GPT-6.1 Sol that rejects a second session once the day's un-refunded debits hit the limit.
Updated the model picker wording beside GPT-6.1 Sol to state it is free in the US and paid elsewhere.
Changed the streak bonus so it lifts the daily Freebucks allowance instead of sitting in the wallet, and vanishes when that day's pool resets.
Updated streak bonus copy to stop telling east-of-Pacific readers the credit is in their wallet.
Added a residential-proxy notice that names the likely cause when a household line is listed as a residential proxy.
Added a VPN availability notice explaining that VPN users get a smaller free Freebucks pool and fewer models than direct connections.
Added an optional note field to the daily Freebucks window that carries the reason the daily pool is this size.
Fixed streak bonus copy that misled east-of-Pacific users whose credit landed on their previous local day.
Changed steering messages sent while a run is in progress to be framed as mid-turn so models keep the running task.
Updated the in-progress prompt placeholder to 'Add to the current task' instead of the ordinary prompt.
Added an in-flight sweep so a sponsored run that dies before writing a terminal report is reported failed by the next CLI launch.
Added partial-edit undo so a process that dies before writing a terminal report is reported failed by the next CLI launch.
Changed prompt-error returns to send a state snapshot instead of the live session, preventing post-error writes from bleeding into persisted state.
Released an unclosed head think tag as text when the model finishes the step, and held mid-answer tags to release as text.
Added UTM tagging to developer-facing ad links in sponsored procedures, leaving existing advertiser tags untouched.
Added source tags to ad request messages to distinguish user-typed input from runtime-synthesized messages.
Added a post-click return label for ad clicks that records click-to-next-prompt latency for terminal users.
Updated placement totals to show an invoiced CPM value line in the advertiser dashboard.
Removed the Freebuff web chat surface from the house ad copy catalog.
Updated house ad subscription promotion copy for the built-in subscription promotion.
Pinned the Muse Spark OpenRouter lane to Meta's endpoint with a price ceiling so traffic cannot be rerouted.
Tightened release download origins to https codebuff or freebuff hosts or loopback with strict semver versions.
